blocks.goal: Move storage- and file-IO-related responsibilities out of CompilationUnit into a dedicated helper class to remove direct dependencies on Files, Paths and CodeGenerationUtils from CompilationUnit.

inputs: CompilationUnit.setStorage(Path) overloads (the constructors that create Storage)
outputs: CompilationUnit: replace inner Storage with field of type CompilationUnitStorage and delegate calls
ops.details: Extract the inner static class Storage into a new top-level class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitStorage. Move all methods and constructors that deal with file location, encoding and saving/reparsing (getPath, getEncoding, getFileName, getDirectory, getSourceRoot, save variants, reparse) into the new class. Replace the private field 'storage' in CompilationUnit with a field of type CompilationUnitStorage, update the setStorage(...) factory methods to instantiate CompilationUnitStorage and update getStorage() to return Optional.ofNullable(storage) as before. Update imports in both classes. The extraction isolates all usages of java.nio.file.Files, java.nio.file.Path (Paths.get), com.github.javaparser.utils.CodeGenerationUtils and related static util calls (subtractPaths/packageToPath) into the new class.

Add imports required by the extracted class (Files, Paths, Charset, Function, IOException, JavaParser, ParseResult, Providers.provider static usage) into CompilationUnitStorage. Remove those imports from CompilationUnit if they are no longer used there. Keep imports used elsewhere in CompilationUnit.

inputs: CompilationUnit methods that create or reference Storage: setStorage(Path), setStorage(Path, Charset), getStorage(), getPrimaryTypeName()
outputs: CompilationUnit updated to construct and delegate to CompilationUnitStorage
ops.details: Update in-class call sites so that where Storage was constructed (new Storage(this, path, charset)) the new class is constructed (new CompilationUnitStorage(this, path, charset)). Update any method references to Storage::getFileName used by getPrimaryTypeName to use the new class instance. Ensure getStorage() returns Optional.ofNullable(storage) where storage is of type CompilationUnitStorage.

blocks.goal: Extract import-management and top-level type lookup helpers from CompilationUnit into a new utility class to remove direct dependencies on ClassUtils, Objects and Collectors from the target class.

outputs: CompilationUnit: remove method bodies and delegate to CompilationUnitUtils where appropriate
ops.details: Extract import-related logic (all addImport overloads, isImplicitImport, getImportPackageName) and top-level type lookup methods (getClassByName, getInterfaceByName, getEnumByName, getAnnotationDeclarationByName, getRecordByName, getLocalDeclarationFromClassname) into a new helper class CompilationUnitUtils. The new helper should be constructed with a reference to a CompilationUnit instance (or accept a CompilationUnit parameter for static helpers) so it can access and mutate imports and types via existing getters/setters. Move the use of com.github.javaparser.utils.ClassUtils and java.util.Objects and java.util.stream.Collectors into the new helper class so CompilationUnit no longer directly depends on them. Update CompilationUnit to delegate calls to the helper and update or remove imports for ClassUtils, Objects and Collectors if no longer used in CompilationUnit.

Add imports required by the new helper (java.util.stream.Collectors, java.util.Objects, com.github.javaparser.utils.ClassUtils) to CompilationUnitUtils. Remove those imports from CompilationUnit if they are no longer used there. Ensure imports for types still used by CompilationUnit remain.

inputs: All internal and external call sites within CompilationUnit that previously invoked the moved methods
outputs: CompilationUnit updated to delegate to CompilationUnitUtils
ops.details: Where the moved methods were used inside the class, replace direct implementations with delegation to CompilationUnitUtils (either via a private helper field or static call with this as parameter). Update unit tests and any internal call sites inside CompilationUnit to call through the helper. Ensure method visibility and nullability semantics are preserved.
